name: PT Prodia Diagnostic Line Tbk
summary: PT Prodia Diagnostic Line Tbk manufactures in vitro diagnostic medical devices in Indonesia. The company offers various products for clinical chemistry, hematology, immunoassay, biomolecular diagnostics, rapid diagnostic tests, and urinalysis. It also offers reagents, calibrators and controls, instruments, and kits. The company was formerly known as PT DiaLine Systems Indonesia and changed its name to PT Prodia Diagnostic Line Tbk in April 2011. PT Prodia Diagnostic Line Tbk was founded in 2010 and is based in Bekasi, Indonesia.
